A crypto futures lab that paper-trades before risking a rupee.

Crypto AI analyses BTC, ETH and SOL perpetuals on Binance, generates signals from 12 strategies and paper-trades them with ₹1,00,000 of virtual capital, so every strategy is tested on the live market before real money is involved.

See the builder's portfolio Open the app

Paper trading only. Live trading is a deliberately gated final phase. The app needs a sign-in; this page is the public overview.

What it does

The parts that make Crypto AI different, in plain terms.

  • 12 strategies, one codebase

    The same pure functions power the backtester and the live scanner.

  • Backtests that try to break

    Slippage and funding costs, parameter sweeps, out-of-sample and walk-forward tests, and Monte Carlo.

  • A paper broker with real risk rules

    Position sizing, a leverage cap, a limit on open trades, a daily-loss kill switch and trailing stops.

  • A live scanner

    Scans promoted strategies every 60 seconds and streams signals with entry, stop, target and confidence.

  • An adaptive layer that asks first

    Regime detection and a scikit-learn meta-label filter. The agent proposes bounded changes that I approve or reject, and never trades on its own.

How it's built

Designed, built and run end to end by one engineer.

  • Python 3.12
  • FastAPI
  • SQLAlchemy + SQLite
  • pandas / NumPy
  • scikit-learn
  • React + Vite
  • lightweight-charts
